chapter.v:
Then answered
Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

Dominion and
fear are with him;He maketh peace in his high places.

Is there
any number of his armies?And upon whom doth not his light arise?

How then
can man be just with God?Or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

Behold, even
the moon hath no brightness,And the stars are not pure in his sight:

How much
less man, that is a worm!And the son of man, that is a worm!
